request.description: List the available animation presets along with their perspectives and the eight supported compass directions (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW). Synchronous GET with no request body: it returns an animations array (each with id, name, category, description, duration, and preview_url), a deduplicated perspectives array, and the directions list. This is a free discovery endpoint and does not charge credits. Use it to obtain the preset_id, perspective, and direction values that transferMotion needs, and to find motion preset names you can reference when animating; pair it with transferMotion (to apply a preset onto a sprite), animateSprite (text-prompt animation), or animate3DModelPreset (apply any preset by id to a rigged 3D model). Requires an API key (user scope).

request.description: List the styles Directional Sprites can render a 3D model in, with the perspectives (camera heights) and the eight directions they render from. Each style has an id (pass it as style_id), a label, a description, a family, whether it is pixel art, a thumbnail_url of the style at its defaults, its current version, and its settings: each setting has a name (the key in style_params), a kind (choice, bool or color - a color setting also takes any colour), its options ({label, value}) and its default. advanced_settings work the same way. Free discovery endpoint: it does not charge credits. Use it before previewDirectionalSprites, createDirectionalSprites and createDirectionalStills. Requires an API key (user scope).

**Deprecated:** prefer `GET /assets/generations` (all types, paginated, same source filter). This endpoint continues to work; no removal is scheduled.
List spritesheets you previously generated through the API, most recent first. This is a free read-only history lookup (no credits, no generation); it does not create anything. Pass an optional request_id query parameter to return only the results tagged with that id when you originally called animateSprite or transferMotion. Requires an API key (user scope).
